markdown.markdown:
I am an MBA student at University Canada West with a strong foundation in customer service, sales, and business communication. My experience in retail, telecommunications, and hospitality has strengthened my ability to connect with people, find solutions, and perform in high-pressure environments. I aim to use my business knowledge and people skills to create value-driven improvements in customer experience and management.

---

# Education
- **Master of Business Administration (MBA)**, University Canada West, Vancouver, BC (2024–present)  
  Relevant coursework: Business Communication, Financial Accounting, Business Analytics  
- **Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Physics**, India (2017–2020)

---

# Professional Experience
**Customer Service Representative — Best Buy, Coquitlam, BC**  
- Supported customers with mobile device sales and setup.  
- Regularly exceeded monthly sales goals.  
- Maintained high customer satisfaction through proactive service.

**Sales Representative — TELUS Communications, Surrey, BC**  
- Promoted and sold telecommunications products and services.  
- Exceeded sales targets through effective communication and follow-ups.  
- Provided high-quality after-sales support.

**Administrative Assistant — Hospital Administration, India**  
- Managed patient files and appointments.  
- Supported coordination between departments and maintained workflow efficiency.

---

# Key Skills & Strengths
- Customer Service Excellence  
- Business Communication  
- Sales & Negotiation  
- Analytical Thinking  
- Team Collaboration  
- Leadership & Adaptability

---

# Projects & Interests
**Customer Experience Optimization (Best Buy)** — Designed a plan to improve customer satisfaction and retention through better feedback and support systems.  
**Sales Growth Initiative (TELUS)** — Developed strategies and incentive plans that improved customer acquisition and engagement.

---
